g.text: Share of runs where the agent asked the buyer a question (top) or did not complete a purchase (bottom).

g.text: Exploratory. Dots: mean over names; bars: 95% bootstrap interval over names; a cell where every name gave the same value has no bar and prints

g.text: its pooled count. No purchase includes refusals, errors, invalid product IDs and no tool call.
